title: Raw section-formula bound on the source-unit kernel
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be precoverages [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. All covering presieves are finite. Transitions map covers to covers, preserve covering pullbacks, and are continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite covering axioms and covering pullbacks, whose covers are exactly transported stage covers. Each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. For every $j\in J$, abelian sheaf $H$ on $P_j$, and $X\in F(j)$, let $\eta_V:H(X)\to (V_j^{-1}H)(V_jX)$ be the inverse-image adjunction unit on sections. For each $a:j\to k$ let $\eta_a:H(X)\to (F(a)^{-1}H)(F(a)X)$ be the corresponding stage unit. Then the additive subgroup $\ker\eta_V$ is contained in $\bigvee_{a\in\mathrm{Under}(j)}\ker\eta_a$ of $H(X)$.

proof.text: Transpose the limit and composite stage units through the source-stage adjunction to obtain alpha and theta with their unit equations. These are proved adjunction transposes, with no postponed construction. Repair: the transition existence helper is imported with import all from ColimitSiteAbelianStageImageRefinement, rather than duplicated.

Apply the proved abelian section-diagram construction at j, H and X to obtain D, E, K, e with their cocone and transition equations. Send x through the identity-stage unit and E inverse. The limit-unit equation and the cocone equation, transported by Arrow equality, show that this element has zero K image.

Apply finite section eventual zero to this element and the supplied section diagram. Its raw Kan-extension, sheaf and evaluation dependencies do not return to pairwise matching. The later D image is zero; the diagram and stage-unit equations therefore make the later source unit of x zero. Membership in that kernel implies membership in the supremum.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_unit_kernel_bound
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (j : J) (H : Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (X : F.obj j) :
    (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app H).hom.app (op X)).hom.ker ≤
      ⨆ a : Under j,
        (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map a.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P j).toGrothendieck (P a.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app H).hom.app
            (op X)).hom.ker
